snippet.title: Mineral Madness – Demo Launch Trailer (Official)
snippet.description:
Chaos has evolved. The moles are ready.  
The Mineral Madness Demo is live now on Steam! 🧨  

Descend into a world of digging, sabotage, and underground anarchy in this multiplayer party brawler where competitive moles fight to deposit minerals—and stop everyone else from doing the same.

🎮 Experience the Demo:  
You’ll dive into fast-paced Free-for-All battles and a relaxed Sandbox Mode to test your digging and grappling skills. Every map is randomly generated, meaning no two matches are ever the same.

🔍 Demo Features:  
💥 Online Free-for-All (2–8 players)  
🛠️ Single-Player Sandbox Mode  
🗺️ Destructible, randomly generated caves  

🔮 Coming in the Full Version:  
• More tools, gadgets, and custom loadouts  
• Team-based multiplayer modes  
• Power-ups, hotspots, and even more chaos  

Play now. Dig deep. Sabotage wisely.  
👉 [Insert Steam Demo Link]  https://store.steampowered.com/app/3925360/Mineral_Madness_Demo/
📣 Join the Mole Network on Discord: https://discord.gg/au3f7XKqyT
